author: zeldadickrider
quote:
I'm a Zelda **** rider. I love that kids' slop game. I spent 167 hours on that game. But after playing GTA 6 for the first time, I can finally admit as a Zelda and Nintendo **** rider that GTA 6 is the most immersive, cinematic, next-level peak game I have ever played in my entire life. The world, the details, the freedom, everything is just on another planet. Nothing else even comes close. I can already see GTA 6 getting review-bombed from the Zelda and Nintendo community because they can’t handle how hard it goes.

GREATEST GAME OF ALL TIME IS GTA 6  
NO DEBATE  
ABSOLUTE MASTERPIECE

- ZELDA **** RIDER
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
